I told Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team that the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is for 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since then changes it.

Hollis is in #central-team and on the Central team, so they could already see that message. A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share. I only read #central-team to answer this.
